registration_condition: The analyzed application registration branch is taken only when factory.board.id differs from CN.
evidence: The recorder registration array includes four descriptors. The reminder creates content before storing its application root, so its scoped calls use descriptor root as the active slot. The interrupt destroy callback has no application state to clear, so its guard uses only descriptor root. Upload state is allocated and cleared during its lifecycle.
scope: Recorded shared calls and descriptor callback slots; not all recording, playback, storage, upload, or interruption paths.
limitations: Recording and upload callbacks affect saved recordings and device state. Do not infer functionality on CN boards from static descriptors. Page slots do not prove thread quiescence. Device behavior and recovery remain unverified.
